title: Murray's Cheese — cheese distributor
body:
Murray's Cheese is a business distributor operating in the cheese trade, serving retailers, grocers, specialty shops, and food-service buyers. A home-base maker of fresh-made homemade cheese would approach this distributor as a wholesale account, supplying finished, labelled product in case quantities for onward sale to shops and markets. Its operating region is recorded as New York, United States.

Distributors of this kind handle ordering, warehousing, and onward delivery, and they judge a new product on shelf life, packaging, labelling, consistent supply, and repeat demand. For cheese, freshness dating, storage conditions, and clear ingredient labelling matter on every shipment, and small makers do best when they can promise steady restocking rather than a single large delivery.

This directory entry records the business as a distribution contact for cheese. It is a business listing only, drawn from the distributor's public wholesale presence, and it is intended to help a home-base company plan real wholesale outreach, region by region.
